gaps.criterion: Every transmission writes an audit entry
gaps.gap: The entry is emitted and asserted in-process: a test proves capture.created is appended naming the domain, the source-URL retention choice and channel browser_extension, and a second proves NO entry is appended when the domain policy refuses, since a write that did not happen must not be recorded. But it cannot LAND upstream. ProjexCloud rejects it with UnregisteredEventType - capture.created, like all 32 LeadFlow event names, is absent from EVENT_TYPE_REGISTRY, a closed code constant in packages/contracts that a consuming app has no endpoint or documented path to extend. Same blocker as bd5ea1b4#AC4 and 7b9e97d6#AC4, recorded as defect 6 in docs/projexcloud-defects.md. appendAuditEntry never throws by design so no capture fails, but the chain stays empty.
